big_picture_notes: Revelation blends epistle (1:4), prophecy (1:3; 22:7,10), and apocalypse (1:1). Its macro‑architecture is heptadic: letters to seven churches, then three septets (seals, trumpets, bowls), framed by the epistolary prologue and the new‑creation epilogue. Recapitulation cycles, OT allusions, parataxis, and inclusios/chiasms shape the vision. Titles like ‘Alpha and Omega’ frame the whole (1:8; 22:13). Scene divisions often follow speaker changes, vision formulae (‘I saw…’), or completed symbolic units.

stories.story_title: The Mandate and the Seven Candlesticks
stories.why_start_end_and_literary_glue: Start (1:1) title/prologue; end (3:22) the seventh ‘hear what the Spirit says’ closes the church oracles. Glue: sevenfold pattern (churches/spirits/lampstands), repeated oracle formulas (‘to the angel… write…’, ‘he who has an ear…’), and the commission ‘write what you have seen…’ (1:19).

scenes.scene_name: Title, Purpose, and Blessing
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: Apocalypse superscription; blessing on reader/hearers. Devices: prologue benediction, prophecy self‑designation.

scenes.scene_name: Epistolary Salutation and Divine Authority
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: ‘John to the seven churches…’; Alpha/Omega declaration closes. Devices: tricolon of Christ’s titles, doxology, coming‑with‑clouds oracle, inclusio title.

scenes.scene_name: John on Patmos: Write to the Seven Churches
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: John, brother and partner in tribulation, on Patmos for God's word; in the Spirit on the Lord's Day, a trumpet voice says: write what you see to the seven churches.

scenes.scene_name: The Son of Man Among the Lampstands
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: Turning, he saw seven golden lampstands and One like the Son of Man in a long robe with golden sash; hair white as snow, eyes like fire, feet like bronze, voice like many waters; seven stars in His right hand, a double-edged sword from His mouth, face like the sun.

scenes.scene_name: Commission and Interpretation Key
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: ‘Do not fear; I am First and Last’; write the seen/now/later; stars/lampstands explained. Devices: theophany speech, interpretive gloss.

scenes.scene_name: Ephesus: Labor and Perseverance
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: To Ephesus: the One holding seven stars and walking among lampstands; I know your deeds, labor, perseverance, and that you tested false apostles and exposed them as liars; you endured without growing weary.

scenes.scene_name: Ephesus: Abandoned First Love; Tree of Life
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: I have this against you: you abandoned your first love; repent and do the deeds you did at first, or I will remove your lampstand; you hate the Nicolaitans' works; to the overcomer I will grant the tree of life in God's paradise.

scenes.scene_name: Oracle to Smyrna — Crown of Life
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: Poverty yet rich; testing; second death immunity. Devices: irony, synagogue of Satan, victor’s crown.

scenes.scene_name: Oracle to Pergamum — Hidden Manna & White Stone
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: Where Satan’s throne; Balaam/Balak; promise of manna/stone. Devices: typology with Numbers, symbolic gifts.

scenes.scene_name: Thyatira: Deeds Greater Than First; Jezebel Tolerated
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: To Thyatira: the Son of God with eyes like fire and feet like bronze; I know your deeds — your latest greater than your first; but you tolerate Jezebel, who calls herself prophetess and misleads My servants into immorality and idol food.

scenes.scene_name: Jezebel's Sickness Bed and the Search of Hearts
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: I gave her time to repent but she is unwilling; I will cast her on a bed of sickness and strike her children dead; all churches will know I search minds and hearts and repay each according to deeds.

scenes.scene_name: Thyatira: Hold Fast; Morning Star to the Overcomer
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: To the rest who do not hold Jezebel's teaching: no further burden, only hold fast until I come; the overcomer who continues My work I will give authority over nations with an iron scepter, and the morning star; hear what the Spirit says.

scenes.scene_name: Oracle to Sardis — Wake Up; White Garments
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: Name of life yet dead; watchfulness; book of life. Devices: thief‑coming simile, vesture imagery.

scenes.scene_name: Philadelphia: Open Door; Synagogue of Satan Will Bow
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: To Philadelphia: the Holy and True One holding the key of David; I have placed an open door no one can shut; you have little strength yet kept My word; I will make the synagogue of Satan bow at your feet and know I love you.

scenes.scene_name: Philadelphia: Kept From Trial; a Pillar in God's Temple
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: Because you kept My command to persevere, I will keep you from the hour of testing; I am coming soon — hold fast so no one takes your crown; the overcomer I will make a pillar in God's temple, writing on him God's name, the new Jerusalem, and My new name; hear what the Spirit says.

scenes.scene_name: Laodicea: Lukewarm — About to Be Vomited Out
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: To Laodicea: the Amen, the faithful and true Witness, the Originator of God's creation; you are neither cold nor hot — I wish you were one or the other! Because you are lukewarm, I am about to vomit you out of My mouth.

scenes.scene_name: Laodicea: Wretched, Poor, Blind, Naked — Buy From Me
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: You say 'I am rich and need nothing,' but you are wretched, pitiful, poor, blind, and naked; buy from Me gold refined by fire, white garments, and eye salve; those I love I rebuke and discipline — be earnest and repent.

scenes.scene_name: Laodicea: I Stand at the Door; Sit With Me on My Throne
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: I stand at the door and knock; if anyone hears and opens, I will come in and dine with him; to the overcomer I will grant the right to sit with Me on My throne, as I overcame and sat with My Father; hear what the Spirit says.

stories.story_title: The Throne Room and the Seven Seals
stories.why_start_end_and_literary_glue: Start (4:1) ‘Come up here’ moves to the heavenly vision; end (8:1) silence at seventh seal closes the first septet. Glue: throne‑scene doxologies, the Lamb and the sealed scroll, rhythmic ‘Come!’ of the first four seals, and interlude protection of the saints.

scenes.scene_name: A Throne in Heaven: Jasper, Carnelian, Emerald Rainbow
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: After this a door stood open in heaven; the trumpet voice said 'Come up here'; at once in the Spirit, John saw a throne in heaven with One seated on it, looking like jasper and carnelian, an emerald rainbow encircling the throne.

scenes.scene_name: Twenty-Four Elders and Four Living Creatures
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: Twenty-four thrones with twenty-four elders in white garments and golden crowns; from the throne came lightning, thunder, and seven torches of fire; before the throne was a sea of glass like crystal, and four living creatures covered with eyes.

scenes.scene_name: Holy, Holy, Holy: the Creator Is Worthy
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: The four living creatures: lion, calf, man's face, eagle — each with six wings, never ceasing: 'Holy, Holy, Holy is the Lord God Almighty'; the elders fall down, casting crowns, worshiping: 'Worthy are You to receive glory and honor and power, for You created all things.'

scenes.scene_name: Sealed Scroll and John’s Weeping
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: No one worthy; John weeps. Devices: narrative tension around sealed book, strong angel proclamation.

scenes.scene_name: The Lion-Lamb Takes the Scroll
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: An elder says: do not weep — the Lion of Judah, the Root of David, has triumphed; John saw a Lamb standing as though slain, with seven horns and seven eyes, the seven spirits sent into all the earth; He came and took the scroll from the right hand of the One seated on the throne.

scenes.scene_name: New Song: Purchased by Your Blood
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: The four living creatures and twenty-four elders fell before the Lamb, each with a harp and golden bowls of incense — the prayers of the saints; they sang a new song: 'Worthy to take the scroll, for You were slain and purchased for God people from every tribe and tongue and nation; You made them a kingdom and priests.'

scenes.scene_name: Myriads of Angels: Worthy Is the Lamb
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: John heard myriads of myriads of angels encircling the throne, saying with a loud voice: 'Worthy is the Lamb to receive power, riches, wisdom, strength, honor, glory, and blessing'; every creature in heaven and earth joined: 'To Him who sits on the throne and to the Lamb be praise forever!' The elders fell down and worshiped.

scenes.scene_name: First Seal: the White Horse
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: The Lamb opened the first seal; one of the four living creatures said 'Come!' A white horse appeared; its rider held a bow, was given a crown, and rode out to conquer.

scenes.scene_name: Second Seal: the Red Horse
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: The second seal: a bright red horse; its rider was permitted to take peace from the earth so men would slay one another; a great sword was given to him.

scenes.scene_name: Third Seal: the Black Horse
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: The third seal: a black horse with a pair of scales; a voice among the living creatures: 'A quart of wheat for a denarius, three quarts of barley for a denarius; do not harm the oil and wine.'

scenes.scene_name: Fourth Seal: the Pale Horse
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: The fourth seal: a pale green horse; its rider's name was Death, and Hades followed; they were given authority over a fourth of the earth to kill by sword, famine, plague, and wild beasts.

scenes.scene_name: Fifth Seal — Cry of the Martyrs
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: Souls under altar ask ‘how long?’; given white robes, told to rest. Devices: altar imagery, oracle of delay.

scenes.scene_name: Sixth Seal — Cosmic Upheaval
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: Quake, darkened sun, blood‑moon, falling stars; ‘who can stand?’ Devices: catastrophe similes, day‑of‑wrath question.

scenes.scene_name: Holding Back the Winds; Sealing the Servants
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: Four angels at the four corners holding back the four winds; another angel ascending from the east with the seal of the living God: 'Do not harm the land, sea, or trees until we seal the servants of God on their foreheads'; John heard the number: 144,000 from all the tribes of Israel.

scenes.scene_name: The 144,000 Sealed by Tribe
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: Judah 12,000, Reuben 12,000, Gad 12,000, Asher 12,000, Naphtali 12,000, Manasseh 12,000, Simeon 12,000, Levi 12,000, Issachar 12,000, Zebulun 12,000, Joseph 12,000, Benjamin 12,000.

scenes.scene_name: Great Multitude in White Robes
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: A multitude too large to count from every nation, tribe, people, and tongue, standing before the throne and the Lamb in white robes with palm branches; crying: 'Salvation to our God and to the Lamb!' All the angels, elders, and living creatures fell facedown: 'Blessing, glory, wisdom, thanks, honor, power, and strength to our God forever!'

scenes.scene_name: Washed in the Lamb's Blood; the Shepherd Wipes Tears
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: An elder asked who these are; 'They came out of the great tribulation and washed their robes white in the Lamb's blood'; therefore they serve God day and night in His temple; never hunger or thirst; the Lamb shepherds them to living water; God wipes away every tear.

scenes.scene_name: Seventh Seal — Silence
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: Opened; half‑hour silence in heaven. Devices: dramatic pause, septet closure.

stories.story_title: The Seven Trumpets and Temple Interludes
stories.why_start_end_and_literary_glue: Start (8:2) seven angels with trumpets and incense; end (11:19) seventh trumpet and opened temple/ark. Glue: trumpet sequence with interposed visions (little scroll, two witnesses), and ‘woe’ eagle marking last three trumpets.

scenes.scene_name: Incense and Trumpet Commission
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: Seven angels receive trumpets; incense with prayers; censer cast to earth. Devices: altar/prayer linkage, thunder/lightning prelude.

scenes.scene_name: Trumpets 1–4 — Earth/Sea/Rivers/Heaven
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: Hail‑fire, burning mountain, Wormwood, darkened lights. Devices: Exodus plagues echo, fourfold natural spheres.

scenes.scene_name: Eagle’s Three Woes
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: ‘Woe, woe, woe’ to earth‑dwellers for remaining blasts. Devices: solitary herald scene, transition marker.

scenes.scene_name: Star Opens the Abyss; Locusts Like Scorpions
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: The fifth trumpet: a star fallen from heaven was given the key to the Abyss; he opened it and smoke like a great furnace darkened the sun and air; locusts came out with power like scorpions.

scenes.scene_name: Torment Five Months; Men Seek Death but Cannot Find It
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: They were told not to harm grass, plants, or trees, only those without God's seal; not permitted to kill but to torment five months; in those days men will seek death but not find it — death will escape them.

scenes.scene_name: Locusts Like War Horses; King Abaddon; First Woe Passed
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: The locusts looked like horses prepared for battle, with gold crowns, human faces, women's hair, lions' teeth, iron breastplates; wings like chariots rushing to battle; tails with scorpion stingers; their king is the angel of the Abyss — Abaddon in Hebrew, Apollyon in Greek. The first woe has passed; two woes still follow.

scenes.scene_name: Sixth Trumpet: Four Angels Released at the Euphrates
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: A voice from the four horns of the golden altar: release the four angels bound at the Euphrates; they were prepared for the hour, day, month, and year to kill a third of mankind; the mounted troops numbered two hundred million.

scenes.scene_name: Horses With Lions' Heads: Fire, Smoke, Sulfur
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: The riders had breastplates of fire, sapphire, and sulfur; the horses' heads were like lions', and from their mouths proceeded fire, smoke, and sulfur — a third of mankind killed by these three plagues; their tails like snakes with heads to inflict harm.

scenes.scene_name: No Repentance: Still Worshiping Demons and Idols
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: The rest of mankind not killed did not repent of the works of their hands — worshiping demons and idols of gold, silver, bronze, stone, and wood that cannot see, hear, or walk; nor did they repent of murder, sorcery, immorality, and theft.

scenes.scene_name: Mighty Angel and the Seven Thunders Sealed
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: Another mighty angel descending from heaven, wrapped in a cloud, rainbow above his head, face like the sun, legs like pillars of fire; right foot on the sea, left on the land; he cried out and seven thunders sounded; John was about to write but a voice said: seal up what the seven thunders said, do not write it.

scenes.scene_name: No More Delay: the Mystery of God Fulfilled
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: The angel swore by the eternal Creator: 'There will be no more delay! In the days of the seventh angel's trumpet, the mystery of God will be fulfilled, as He proclaimed to His servants the prophets.'

scenes.scene_name: Eat the Little Scroll: Sweet and Bitter
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: The voice told John: take the scroll from the angel's hand; he said: eat it — sweet as honey in your mouth but bitter in your stomach; John ate it, sweet in mouth, stomach turned bitter; they told him: 'You must prophesy about many peoples, nations, tongues, and kings.'

scenes.scene_name: Measure the Temple; the Nations Trample 42 Months
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: John was given a measuring rod: measure God's temple and altar and count the worshipers; exclude the outer court — it has been given to the nations, who will trample the holy city for 42 months.

scenes.scene_name: Two Witnesses in Sackcloth: Fire and Plagues
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: I will empower My two witnesses to prophesy 1,260 days in sackcloth; they are the two olive trees and lampstands before the Lord; if anyone harms them, fire devours their enemies; they have power to shut the sky, turn waters to blood, and strike the earth with plagues.

scenes.scene_name: The Beast Kills Them; the World Gloats for Three Days
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: When they finish their testimony, the beast from the Abyss wages war, overpowers, and kills them; their bodies lie in the street of the great city called Sodom and Egypt; for three and a half days all peoples view the bodies and refuse burial, gloating and exchanging gifts — these prophets tormented them.

scenes.scene_name: Resurrected and Ascended; a Tenth of the City Falls
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: After three and a half days the breath of life entered them; they stood on their feet and great fear fell on all; a loud voice said 'Come up here' and they ascended to heaven in a cloud; in that hour a great earthquake collapsed a tenth of the city and killed seven thousand; the rest gave glory to God.

scenes.scene_name: Seventh Trumpet — Kingdom Proclaimed
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: ‘The kingdom… has become the Lord’s and his Christ’; worship; temple opened and ark seen. Devices: royal proclamation, doxology, covenant‑ark epiphany.

stories.story_title: The Woman, the Dragon, and the Beasts
stories.why_start_end_and_literary_glue: Start (12:1) great sign in heaven; end (14:20) double harvest completes conflict‑cycle contrast with the Lamb’s company and messages. Glue: woman/dragon war, sea/earth beasts (authority/propaganda), then Lamb/144,000 and three‑angel gospel and warnings.

scenes.scene_name: Woman, Child, and Dragon
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: Pregnant woman; dragon seeks child; child caught up; woman flees. Devices: sign imagery, wilderness motif.

scenes.scene_name: War in Heaven; Woe to Earth
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: Michael defeats dragon; accuser cast down; saints conquer by blood/word. Devices: victory hymn, timing (‘short time’).

scenes.scene_name: Dragon Pursues the Woman’s Seed
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: Serpent pursues; earth helps; war on her offspring. Devices: Exodus echo (flood/earth), remnant identification.

scenes.scene_name: The Beast From the Sea: the Dragon's Authority
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: A beast with ten horns and seven heads rising from the sea, with blasphemous names; like a leopard, feet of a bear, mouth of a lion; the dragon gave it power, throne, and authority; one head seemed mortally wounded but was healed; the world marveled and worshiped the dragon and the beast: 'Who is like the beast?'

scenes.scene_name: Blasphemy and Authority for 42 Months
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: The beast was given a mouth for arrogant blasphemy and authority for 42 months; it blasphemed God, His name, and His tabernacle; it waged war against the saints and conquered them; all earth dwellers worshiped it — all whose names were not written in the Book of Life of the slain Lamb from the foundation of the world.

scenes.scene_name: A Call for Perseverance: Captivity and the Sword
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: He who has an ear, let him hear: if anyone is destined for captivity, into captivity he goes; if anyone is to die by the sword, by the sword he must be killed. Here is a call for the perseverance and faith of the saints.

scenes.scene_name: The Beast From the Earth: Fire From Heaven
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: Another beast rising from the earth with two horns like a lamb but speaking like a dragon; it exercised the first beast's authority and made the earth worship the first beast; it performed great signs, even causing fire to come down from heaven to earth in people's presence.

scenes.scene_name: The Image Given Breath; the Mark of the Beast
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: It deceived the earth dwellers, telling them to make an image of the wounded beast; it was permitted to give breath to the image so it could speak and kill those who refused to worship; it required all — small and great, rich and poor, free and slave — to receive a mark on the right hand or forehead.

scenes.scene_name: No Buying or Selling Without the Mark: 666
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: No one could buy or sell without the mark — the beast's name or the number of its name; here is wisdom: let the one with insight calculate the number of the beast, for it is the number of a man — 666.

scenes.scene_name: Lamb and 144,000 on Mount Zion
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: New song, spotless company; firstfruits to God and Lamb. Devices: purity motif, name/seal contrast with mark.

scenes.scene_name: Three Angels: Eternal Gospel, Babylon Fallen
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: An angel flying overhead with the eternal gospel: 'Fear God and give Him glory, for the hour of His judgment has come; worship the Creator'; a second angel: 'Fallen, fallen is Babylon the great, who made all nations drink the wine of her immorality.'

scenes.scene_name: Third Angel: the Mark and the Wine of God's Wrath
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: A third angel: if anyone worships the beast and receives its mark, he will drink God's wrath undiluted; tormented with fire and sulfur before the holy angels and the Lamb; the smoke of their torment rises forever — no rest day or night for those who worship the beast.

scenes.scene_name: Blessed Are the Dead Who Die in the Lord
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: Here is a call for the perseverance of the saints who keep God's commandments and the faith of Jesus; a voice from heaven: 'Write — blessed are the dead who die in the Lord from now on'; the Spirit: 'they will rest from their labors, for their deeds follow them.'

scenes.scene_name: Harvest of the Earth: the Son of Man's Sickle
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: A white cloud, One like the Son of Man with a golden crown and sharp sickle; an angel from the temple cried: 'Swing Your sickle and reap, for the harvest is ripe'; He swung His sickle and the earth was harvested.

scenes.scene_name: Grapes of Wrath: the Great Winepress
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: Another angel with a sharp sickle; an angel from the altar cried to him: 'Gather the clusters from the vine of the earth, for its grapes are ripe'; he gathered and threw them into the great winepress of God's wrath; blood flowed as high as horses' bridles for 1,600 stadia outside the city.

stories.why_start_end_and_literary_glue: Start (15:1) sign: seven angels with seven last plagues; end (16:21) seventh bowl ‘It is done’ with quake/hail. Glue: preparatory sanctuary vision (song of Moses/Lamb), then rapid bowls 1–6 and Armageddon, culminating in final bowl.

scenes.scene_name: Sea of Glass Mixed With Fire: the Song of Moses and the Lamb
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: Seven angels with the seven final plagues completing God's wrath; those who conquered the beast stood on a sea of glass mixed with fire, holding harps; they sang the song of Moses and the Lamb: 'Great and wonderful are Your works, O Lord God Almighty; just and true are Your ways, O King of the nations.'

scenes.scene_name: Seven Golden Bowls: the Temple Filled With Smoke
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: The tabernacle of the Testimony in heaven was opened; the seven angels in bright linen with golden sashes came out; one of the four living creatures gave them seven golden bowls full of God's wrath; the temple filled with smoke from God's glory and power — no one could enter until the seven plagues were completed.

scenes.scene_name: Bowls 1-2: Sores and the Sea Turns to Blood
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: A loud voice from the temple: 'Go, pour out the seven bowls of God's wrath'; the first angel poured on the earth — loathsome sores on those with the mark of the beast; the second poured on the sea — it turned to blood like a corpse, and every living thing in the sea died.

scenes.scene_name: Bowls 3-4: Rivers to Blood and the Sun Scorches
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: The third angel poured on the rivers and springs — they turned to blood; the angel of the waters: 'Righteous are You — they spilled the blood of saints and prophets, so You gave them blood to drink'; the altar replied: 'True and just are Your judgments'; the fourth angel poured on the sun — it scorched people with fire.

scenes.scene_name: Bowls 5-6: Beast's Throne Darkened; Euphrates Dried
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: The fifth angel poured on the beast's throne — its kingdom plunged into darkness; men gnawed their tongues and cursed God but did not repent; the sixth angel poured on the Euphrates — its water dried up to prepare the way for the kings of the East.

scenes.scene_name: Frog Spirits and Armageddon
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: Three unclean spirits like frogs from the mouths of the dragon, beast, and false prophet; demonic spirits performing signs, gathering the kings of the earth for battle at Armageddon; 'Behold, I am coming like a thief — blessed is the one who stays awake and clothed.'

scenes.scene_name: Seventh Bowl — ‘It Is Done’
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: Bowl on air; lightning, quake; great hail; Babylon remembered. Devices: theophanic storm, consummation formula, city‑split image.

stories.story_title: Babylon the Great Judged and the Wedding Announced
stories.why_start_end_and_literary_glue: Start (17:1) angel shows judgment of the great prostitute; end (19:10) hallelujahs and marriage supper; John admonished not to worship angel. Glue: vision + interpretation (17), laments over Babylon (18), and heaven’s rejoicing and bride made ready (19:1–10).

scenes.scene_name: The Woman on the Beast
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: Carried to wilderness; woman on scarlet beast; drunk with saints’ blood. Devices: wilderness sign, luxury/abomination contrast.

scenes.scene_name: The Beast That Was, Is Not, and Will Be
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: The angel said: I will tell you the mystery of the woman and the beast with seven heads and ten horns that carries her; the beast was, is no more, and will come up from the Abyss to destruction; earth dwellers whose names are not in the Book of Life will marvel; the seven heads are seven mountains.

scenes.scene_name: Seven Kings: Five Fallen, One Is, One to Come
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: Five kings have fallen, one is, the other has not yet come but will remain only a little while; the beast that was and is not is an eighth king belonging to the seven, going to destruction; the ten horns are ten kings who have not yet received a kingdom.

scenes.scene_name: Ten Kings Yield to the Beast; the Lamb Triumphs
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: The ten kings have one purpose: to yield their power and authority to the beast; they will make war against the Lamb, and the Lamb will triumph — for He is Lord of lords and King of kings — accompanied by His called, chosen, and faithful ones.

scenes.scene_name: The Woman’s Doom by the Beast’s Allies
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: Waters = peoples; horns hate the prostitute; God’s purpose fulfilled. Devices: symbol key, sovereignty motif.

scenes.scene_name: Fallen Is Babylon: a Lair of Demons
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: An angel descending from heaven with great authority, illuminating the earth; he cried: 'Fallen, fallen is Babylon the great! She has become a lair of demons, a haunt of every unclean spirit; all nations drank the wine of her immorality; the merchants grew wealthy from her luxury.'

scenes.scene_name: Come Out of Her, My People; Pay Her Back Double
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: Another voice from heaven: 'Come out of her, My people, so you do not share her sins or plagues; her sins are piled to heaven, and God has remembered her iniquities; pay her back double for her deeds; mix her a double portion in her own cup.'

scenes.scene_name: Queen No More: Plagues in One Day
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: As she glorified herself and lived in luxury, give her equal torment and grief; she says in her heart: 'I sit as queen, I am no widow, I will never see grief'; therefore her plagues will come in one day — death, grief, and famine — and she will be consumed by fire, for mighty is the Lord who judges her.

scenes.scene_name: Kings and Merchants Weep Over Babylon
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: The kings of the earth who committed immorality with her will weep and wail at the sight of her smoke; 'Woe, woe to the great city — in a single hour your judgment has come'; the merchants weep and mourn because no one buys their cargo anymore.

scenes.scene_name: Cargo of Gold and Souls: All Vanished
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: The cargo list: gold, silver, precious stones, pearls, fine linen, purple, silk, scarlet, citron wood, ivory, bronze, iron, marble, cinnamon, spice, incense, myrrh, frankincense, wine, oil, flour, wheat, cattle, sheep, horses, carriages — and bodies and souls of men; 'The fruit your soul desired has departed, never to be seen again.'

scenes.scene_name: Merchants Stand at a Distance in Fear
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: The merchants who sold these things and gained wealth from her will stand at a distance in fear of her torment, weeping and mourning: 'Woe, woe to the great city, clothed in fine linen and purple and scarlet, adorned with gold and precious stones and pearls — in a single hour such wealth has been destroyed!' Every shipmaster, passenger, and sailor will stand at a distance.

scenes.scene_name: Mariners Cry: What City Was Like This?
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: They will cry out at the sight of the smoke: 'What city was ever like this great city?' They will throw dust on their heads and weep and mourn: 'Woe, woe to the great city — in a single hour she has been destroyed'; all who had ships on the sea were enriched by her wealth.

scenes.scene_name: Rejoice, Heaven and Saints; the Millstone Cast
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: Rejoice over her, O heaven, saints, apostles, and prophets — God has judged her for you; a mighty angel cast a millstone into the sea: 'With such violence Babylon will be cast down, never to be seen again'; no harpists, craftsmen, lamp, or bridegroom's voice; in her was found the blood of prophets and saints and all slain on earth.

scenes.scene_name: Hallelujah! Salvation and Glory and Power
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: A great multitude in heaven: 'Hallelujah! Salvation and glory and power belong to our God, for His judgments are true and just; He has judged the great prostitute and avenged the blood of His servants'; a second time: 'Hallelujah! Her smoke rises forever and ever.'

scenes.scene_name: Elders and Living Creatures: Amen, Hallelujah! the Lord Reigns
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: The twenty-four elders and four living creatures fell down and worshiped: 'Amen, Hallelujah!' A voice from the throne: 'Praise our God, all you who serve Him'; a multitude like many waters and thunder: 'Hallelujah! For the Lord our God the Almighty reigns.'

scenes.scene_name: The Marriage of the Lamb; Worship God Alone
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: 'Let us rejoice, for the marriage of the Lamb has come, and His bride has made herself ready — fine linen is the righteous acts of the saints'; blessed are those invited to the marriage supper; John fell to worship the angel, who said: 'Do not do that — I am a fellow servant; worship God, for the testimony of Jesus is the spirit of prophecy.'

stories.story_title: Final Victory and the Last Judgment
stories.why_start_end_and_literary_glue: Start (19:11) rider on white horse appears; end (20:15) great white throne judgment concludes present order. Glue: defeat of beast/false prophet, binding/release of Satan, and judgment of the dead from the books.

scenes.scene_name: The Rider on the White Horse
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: Faithful and True judges/wages war; robe dipped in blood; King of kings. Devices: warfare theophany, name/titles cascade.

scenes.scene_name: Beast and False Prophet Defeated
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: Birds’ supper; beast captured; false prophet cast into lake of fire. Devices: banquet reversal (contrast with wedding), swift judgment.

scenes.scene_name: The Millennium and First Resurrection
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: Satan bound; saints reign thousand years; blessed holy participants. Devices: chaining motif, reign/rest imagery.

scenes.scene_name: Satan’s Final Rebellion and Doom
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: Released deceives nations; fire from heaven; devil cast into lake of fire. Devices: brief recapitulative battle, eternal torment note.

scenes.scene_name: Great White Throne Judgment
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: Earth/sky flee; books opened; death and Hades thrown into lake of fire; anyone not in book of life cast in. Devices: courtroom imagery, book‑of‑life antithesis.

stories.why_start_end_and_literary_glue: Start (21:1) new heaven and new earth; end (22:21) final grace blessing. Glue: bride‑city vision, throne/river/tree, repeated ‘I am coming soon’, blessings and warnings, and Alpha/Omega inclusio.

scenes.scene_name: New Heaven and New Earth; God Dwells With Men
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: A new heaven and new earth — the first had passed away, the sea was no more; the holy city, new Jerusalem, coming down as a bride adorned; a loud voice: 'Behold, the dwelling of God is with men; He will dwell with them; they will be His people; He will wipe away every tear — no more death, mourning, crying, or pain; the former things have passed away.'

scenes.scene_name: It Is Done: the Thirsty and the Overcomers; the Cowardly's Doom
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: The One on the throne: 'Behold, I make all things new — write, for these words are faithful and true; it is done! I am the Alpha and the Omega; to the thirsty I will give the spring of the water of life; the overcomer will inherit all things — I will be his God and he will be My son; but the cowardly, unbelieving, abominable, murderers, sexually immoral, sorcerers, idolaters, and liars will have their place in the lake of fire — the second death.'

scenes.scene_name: Show Me the Bride: the Holy City's Radiance
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: One of the seven bowl angels: 'Come, I will show you the bride, the wife of the Lamb'; he carried John to a great mountain and showed him the holy city Jerusalem descending from heaven, shining with God's glory, radiance like jasper, clear as crystal.

scenes.scene_name: Twelve Gates, Twelve Foundations
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: A great and high wall with twelve gates inscribed with the twelve tribes' names, twelve angels at the gates; three gates on each side; the wall's twelve foundations bore the twelve apostles' names of the Lamb.

scenes.scene_name: Measuring the City: 12,000 Stadia, 144 Cubits
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: An angel with a golden measuring rod measured the city, its gates, and walls; the city lies foursquare — length, width, and height equal at 12,000 stadia; the wall was 144 cubits by human measure.

scenes.scene_name: Jasper Walls, Gold Streets, Pearl Gates
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: The wall was jasper, the city pure gold like glass; the foundations adorned with every precious stone — jasper, sapphire, chalcedony, emerald, sardonyx, carnelian, chrysolite, beryl, topaz, chrysoprase, jacinth, amethyst; the twelve gates were twelve pearls; the main street was pure gold, clear as glass.

scenes.scene_name: Glory of God as Its Light
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: No temple; nations walk by its light; nothing unclean enters. Devices: templelessness motif, nations/kingdoms inclusion.

scenes.scene_name: River and Tree of Life; Reign Forever
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: River from the throne; tree of life heals nations; they see his face and reign. Devices: Eden restored, beatific vision, servant‑reign.

scenes.scene_name: These Words Are Faithful and True; I Am Coming Soon
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: The angel said: 'These words are faithful and true; the Lord, the God of the spirits of the prophets, has sent His angel to show His servants what must soon take place'; 'Behold, I am coming soon — blessed is the one who keeps the words of prophecy in this book'; John fell to worship at the angel's feet.

scenes.scene_name: Do Not Seal the Prophecy; Let the Righteous Continue
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: The angel said: 'Do not do that — I am a fellow servant with you and your brothers the prophets; worship God!'; 'Do not seal up the words of prophecy in this book, for the time is near; let the unrighteous continue in unrighteousness and the holy in holiness.'

scenes.scene_name: My Reward Is With Me; Alpha and Omega
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: 'Behold, I am coming soon, and My reward is with Me, to give to each one according to what he has done; I am the Alpha and the Omega, the First and the Last, the Beginning and the End.'

scenes.scene_name: Blessed Are Those Who Wash Their Robes; the Morning Star
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: Blessed are those who wash their robes, that they may have the right to the tree of life and enter the city by its gates; outside are the dogs, sorcerers, sexually immoral, murderers, idolaters, and all who love falsehood; 'I, Jesus, have sent My angel to testify to you for the churches; I am the Root and Offspring of David, the bright Morning Star.'

scenes.scene_name: The Spirit and Bride Say Come; Do Not Add or Take Away
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: The Spirit and the bride say: 'Come!' Let the one who hears say: 'Come!' Let the thirsty come and drink the water of life freely; if anyone adds to the words of this book, God will add the plagues described in it; if anyone takes away, God will take away his share in the tree of life and the holy city.

scenes.scene_name: Yes, I Am Coming Soon. Amen. Come, Lord Jesus!
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: He who testifies to these things says: 'Yes, I am coming soon'; Amen. Come, Lord Jesus! The grace of the Lord Jesus be with all the saints. Amen.
